text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, under the pretext of "minion training," Shinko Windy dragged me along to a shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A good villain needs good lackeys as an absolute must!
I will train them thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You better listen strictly to whatever Windy-chan, your boss, says!
choice_data_list: Um... what kind of things are we doing?
Um... what kind of things will we be doing?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, it's all about real experience!
Practice makes perfect!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, take the items from that discount corner
and haggle them down even further!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! If I do this,
they're gonna be totally stumped~!
choice_data_list: No, I don't want to cause trouble for the shop...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmmph... Are you talking back to me~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Well, looks like that hurdle was still a bit too high for you.
Then on to the next! The next!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, go and eat every last sample
at the food tasting booth!
choice_data_list: People who actually need it will be in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Geez!! All you ever do is complain!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As punishment for such a henchman,
I shall tickle your tummy!

Wait a minute, Windy.
Do you really think that'll make you a good boss?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ! T-That voice—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dangerous Beauty Mask!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's Seeking the Pearl right now.
More importantly, I heard all about it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
No, looks like it's time to punish my minion, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's right, nanoda! Because she talks back all the time and never listens to a word I say, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So? Have you thought about the cause of that pushback?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A proper balance of the whip and sweet candy—that is the essence of education!
Strict discipline alone won't get through to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, candy...!
I might've forgotten to give you some...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Dangerous Beauty Mask!
You know so much about villains...!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then what you need to do is—
...You know already, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, we eat sweets!
Windy-chan will even give you the strawberry on her cake...
as a special treat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you're tired from walking all over, right?
Then you gotta eat something sweet!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You didn't spill anything and ate
everything up so neatly—such a good girl!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Once your belly is full, you get sleepy, right?
Next up, we're taking a nap in the park!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, I was thoroughly pampered in all sorts of ways...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how's that?!
How do you like Windy-chan's "carrot"?!
choice_data_list: You're good at spoiling people, huh
You're good at spoiling people, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She really defied my expectations in the best way possible.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nishishi! Well, yeah, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Because Mom and Dad always treat Windy-chan so well!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like praising me for doing my best in a race
by taking me to a steakhouse with the chewiest, meatiest steaks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Saying it's amazing that I woke up in the morning, or that my teeth are all shiny and clean!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. So you knew what to do from the start.
In that case, there's nothing left to worry about!
choice_data_list: I'll do my best as your underling!
You can go a bit heavier on the "carrots" instead of the stick.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yep! That's a great answer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep working hard,
I'll give you a "carrot" once in a while like today!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you two are going to make a great pair!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"More, huh? Hmm...
If there's anything else, maybe headpats, or—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Windy? You have to balance the carrot and the stick.
Too much of either isn't good.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
Guess that means it's time for the 'whip' now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna push you hard, so brace yourself, nanodaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy turned out to be a master not only of the 'carrot', but also of the 'stick'.
